quotes.text: # This is a lenient check: if a key isn't in `expected_value`, it isn't checked.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The session test quits in-app, checks session.json, restarts, then compares the restored tab descriptions. It treats the first mail3Pane tab separately from saved secondary tabs. assert_similar checks every expected dictionary key, but lists must have the same length and order. It only checks windows[0], so it is not a full multiwindow persistence test. Use this comparator only when ignored extra metadata is deliberate. Document its partial-object and strict-list semantics.
title: Check both the saved session file and the restored application state
